content.text:
**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (preferred position met). No redline proposed.**

The renewal package in § 8 already sits at our preferred position on every element:

| Preferred element | Where it is met |
|---|---|
| Renewal term ≤ 12 months | § 8.2 — "renews for successive twelve-month periods" (no multi-year auto-renewal) |
| Customer opt-out ≤ 30 days | § 8.2 — "at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal" |
| Vendor reminder ≥ 60 days | § 8.2 — reminder "at least sixty days beforehand," plus opt-out deadline extended 30 days if the reminder is missed |
| Uplift ≤ lesser of CPI and 3% | § 8.3 — lesser of US CPI-U and three percent, with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods |

Coverage checks performed: § 7 (Fees fixed during initial term, no separate escalator), § 29 (non-renewal notice delivery mechanics workable — courier/certified mail plus email, copy to legal@brightline.example), § 2.2/§ 4 (precedence and Order Form formation), plus regex searches for "automatically / successive / Renewal Term / then-current term / days prior / non-renewal" and uplift language. No competing renewal or price-increase provision exists.

Two diligence notes recorded in the rationale rather than flagged:
- § 8.1's three-year **initial** term is outside this rule's scope (the walk-away targets multi-year *renewals*), and MSA expiration does not cut off a live Order Form.
- § 2.2 lets an Order Form vary these terms where it expressly identifies the conflicting provision — worth policing individual Order Forms so no longer notice window or larger uplift creeps in there.
